name: tech-amazon
label: Tech / Amazon products (exact-model, affiliate roundups)
description: Best-of and versus videos about Amazon tech products: every product shot must show the exact manufacturer, model and variant; affiliate links never drive footage search.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).

llmGuidance: Amazon tech product roundup / versus video. Product scenes must show the exact product named (manufacturer + model + variant + generation, e.g. "Apple AirPods Pro 2" not "AirPods 3"). Never search with affiliate links or ASINs. B-roll between products: people using the type of device, desks, homes; never another brand's product. Use spec_card only for specs the narration states; never invent specs or prices.
disclaimer: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Prices and availability change; check the current listing.

pacing._source: data/channel_study/rules_v3.json (tech: 2.07 s median, cuts/min start 21.5 / mid 18 / end 17.5)
pacing._micro: 2.5-4 s micro-scenes cut on voice silences / word starts (src/lib/engine/pacing/autoEditor.ts), each with its active subject + spec (micro_scenes.json).

productMatch._comment: Exact-model rules (src/lib/productResearch.ts). A clip/photo whose title names another generation, variant or model number is rejected; one that only names the family goes to manual review.

affiliate._comment: Amazon URLs/ASINs are recorded per product in product_research.json for the description only; they are never used as footage search terms.
affiliate.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

music._comment: Background music OFF by default; turn it on per channel in style.json music.enabled.
